title: JAMIO NEWS daily publishing contract v1
description: Normalized draft package. Markdown uses JSON front matter; slug and body are derived from the file. Structural validation is not fact verification. Qualified edition slugs require matching date, variant and priceKeys; legacy metadata is unchanged. Explicit evening editions accept 1-5 articles and top stories; other editions retain five top stories.

x-handoff.modeSelection: Use local/work when Node and clone are usable; automatically use remote/scheduled when Web plus GitHub read/write/PR/merge/Actions APIs are available but local execution is not. Never require a clone in remote mode.

writes: data/prices.json (append only; preserve every prior edition digest)
authoritativeCI: Daily publication guard: trusted main validates the whole base/head diff and package
Publish JAMIO NEWS: node scripts/validate.mjs; node --test; node scripts/build.mjs on exact PR head
remote.validationReceipt: JAMIO_DAILY_VALIDATION JSON in successful guard job logs: contractVersion, pr, baseSha, headSha, date, slug, variant, editionUrl, digest. guard-passed alone is not complete CI success.
remote.merge: Require both successful workflows for recorded head/base, re-read PR and main, then merge API with sha=validated head. Record the merge response sha and merged PR merge_commit_sha.
remote.confirmation: Require successful Publish JAMIO NEWS for merged main SHA plus public publication.json contractVersion=1 and exact commit/date/url/digest from validated guard receipt; also check edition HTML canonical/digest. If direct Web cannot retrieve Pages, read JAMIO_PUBLIC_RECEIPT from that exact successful main deployment job: receipt-verified and matching commit/editions/verifiedEdition. Actions fetched and verified the actual public receipt/HTML. No local Node required.
remote.deadline: 07:00 JST is a target, never permission to skip validation or claim unconfirmed publication. Report blocked/pending/late explicitly.

x-handoff.failure: Nonzero exit and JSON status=failed. Do not merge or claim publication. No fabricated news/prices/X retrieval; morning/noon/legacy require five top stories, evening permits 1-5 sourced articles only when editorially warranted.
x-handoff.idempotency: Identical same-edition package is unchanged; differing content or observations is a conflict. Explicit morning/noon/evening editions may coexist with a legacy issue. Every prior digest must remain unchanged. Corrections require a separate reviewed PR with updated/corrections.
x-handoff.success: JSON status=published, date, editionUrl, commit, digest, workflowUrl; only after successful Pages workflow for that main SHA and matching public publication.json and edition HTML.
